title: noc_panel_rows measure pass already diverges from draw pass — scroll clamp strands the drop-log tail
evidence:
rows := i32(2) // header: title + global line
	rows += 2      // drops
	rows += 2      // crisis root causes
…vs draw_noc_panel emitting THREE rows for each: `cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, "DEBUG OVERLAY (D)", NOC_INK)` + `cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, glob, NOC_INK_DIM)` + `cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, hash, NOC_INK_SOFT)` (header 3 not 2; drops lines 454/456/459 = 3 not 2; crisis lines 462/465-or-467/470 = 3 not 2).
detail: The duplicated hand-maintained count (comment: "MUST agree with draw_noc_panel row-for-row") undercounts total by >=3 always, so clamp(scroll,0,total-visible) caps wheel scroll low and the last ~3 drop-log rows are unreachable exactly when the log is long.
recommended_fix: Make the count correct (header 3, drops 3, crisis 3, plus the empty-placeholder and select-readout edges), or derive it single-source by running the row cursor in a measure mode instead of a parallel proc.

title: run-dev.sh collects pass-through args then discards them — documented --stats-out pass-through is dead
evidence:
*) ARGS+=("$1") ;;
…
odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/app-dev "${ARGS[@]+}" 2>&1 | head -20
…
  PP_NOC_E2E=1 ./bin/app-dev
…
  ./bin/app-dev
detail:
"${ARGS[@]+}" expands to one empty string (verified in bash), never the array, and the run lines take no args — so the header-documented `--stats-out

` pass-through silently reaches neither the build nor the app. The D-lesson launch path ships a documented-but-dead knob.
recommended_fix: Pass the array to the app run instead: `odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/app-dev` then `./bin/app-dev "${ARGS[@]}"` (and `PP_NOC_E2E=1 ./bin/app-dev "${ARGS[@]}"`).

title: Out-of-roster class with a known reason double-counts: reason bucket AND drop_other both increment
detail: One Packet_Dropped with class >= 64 and reason Queue_Overflow raises drop_e9 AND drop_other, so E9+E22+other can exceed the event count — against the acceptance line "drop counters summing exactly the Packet_Dropped events". Edge-only (real rosters are far under 64).
recommended_fix: Count the reason bucket only, and track out-of-roster classes in a separate unclassified-class counter (or skip per_class without touching drop_other) so the reason counters always sum to the event total.

title: Stale "F-key" comment on the draw call — the ruled key is D
evidence: // v2-noc: the F-key debug surface (the merged 5.7 + NOC overlay) draws
detail: The user ruling made D the one debug key and dropped F entirely; this comment still names the surface "F-key", contradicting poll.odin, types.odin, and the panel's own "DEBUG OVERLAY (D)" title. Misleading residue of the abandoned F plan.
recommended_fix: Reword to "the D-key debug surface" to match the ruling and the surrounding comments.

title: overlay-check .t1 sidecar silently truncates on partial captures, so the documented byte-identity proof can fail
evidence:
wall_max := min(u64(max(0, i64(cap_ms) * i64(hz) / 1000)), total_wall)
… demos/qos_contention.dem: `run 12000ms`
… goldens/qos_contention.t1: `ticks 240`
… shipped capture: bin/overlay-qos-contention-10000ms.png (10000ms -> 200 wall ticks)
detail: The sidecar holds hashes only up to cap_ms; for a capture shorter than the demo (the shipped 10s capture of a 12s demo: 200 vs 240 hashes) `diff`/`cmp` against goldens/<demo>.t1 cannot be empty, yet the verb prints no warning that the proof needs a full-length capture.
recommended_fix: Warn when wall_max < total_wall ("sidecar is a prefix — not cmp-able against goldens/<demo>.t1"), or document that the AC3 proof requires cap_ms >= the demo's run length.
